description: This file defines interfaces and implementations for managing Kubernetes Deployment resources, including create, update, delete, get, list, watch, patch, apply, and scale operations within the client-go library.

classes.name: deployments
classes.description: Implementation of DeploymentInterface, managing Deployment resources within a specific namespace.

methods.name: GetScale
methods.description: Retrieves the scale subresource for a deployment.

methods.name: UpdateScale
methods.description: Updates the scale subresource for a deployment.

methods.name: ApplyScale
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to the scale subresource of a deployment.
